CVE-2024-45624.title: Exposure of sensitive information due to incompatible policies is ...
CVE-2024-45624.description: Exposure of sensitive information due to incompatible policies issue exists in Pgpool-II. If a database user accesses a query cache, table data unauthorized for the user may be retrieved.

CVE-2025-46801.title: Pgpool-II provided by PgPool Global Development Group contains an ...
CVE-2025-46801.description: Pgpool-II provided by PgPool Global Development Group contains an authentication bypass by primary weakness vulnerability. if the vulnerability is exploited, an attacker may be able to log in to the system as an arbitrary user, allowing them to read or tamper with data in the database, and/or disable the database.
